LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 DETERMINERS: ARTICLES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in use 1.3.1 Determiners: Articles
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in use 1.3.1 Determiners: Articles, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How are articles used with nouns?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in use 1.3.1 Determiners: Articles together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: Originality as learner independently creates a list of sentences that contain articles and share the content via digital

device.

● Digital literacy: Interacting with digital devices as learners uses mobile phone, email, computer printouts to share their list of sentences that

contain articles.

● Communication and collaboration: Articulating signs clearly as learner fingerspell and signs words and phrases related to the theme family.

Values:
● Respect: Acceptance as learner is able to accommodate mistakes made by peers during sentence constructions and

review.

● Love: Sharing as learners assist others as they use technology to share their work.

Link to other subjects

The learner is able to relate the concept of definite and indefinite articles to their learning in Kiswahili.

Word cards, Chart, Class readers, Course books, Flash cards, Recording devices e.g. tablets, mobile phone, Dictionary, Internet, Signed audio-visual
